§6Ferrouranium§f

§aA carbon steel-uranium alloy. Hard, durable, and radiation resistant.§f

§bFerrouranium§f is a carbon steel-uranium (U-238) alloy known for its high hardness and durability, with radiation resistance from its uranium content.

§6Production§f (§bCrucible§f):
§b• 1×§f Uranium-238 Nugget
§b• 2×§f Steel Nuggets
§b→ §e3×§f Ferrouranium Nuggets

§6Key Uses§f:
§b• Ferrouranium Anvil§f, durable high-tier anvil
§b• Ferrouranium Drill Bit§f, tough mining tool
§b• Ducrete§f, reinforced construction material
§b• Weapons§f, high-durability weapon components
§b• HEV MarK IV Power Armor§f, essential armor component
§b• Research Reactor§f and §bBreeding Reactor§f construction
§b• Cooling Tower§f, required for reactor cooling

§ePS:§f The 3:1 output ratio makes ferrouranium efficient to produce. Stockpile nuggets for anvil and drill bit crafting. The anvil is essential for late-game assembly recipes!
